title: Janus Cristal × FractalGPT Sandbox Gate

lineage.provenance_note: Original library bytes and connector-serialized GitHub mirror are intentionally kept as separate identities.

question: Do independent content-free scan paths from the recovered FractalGPT and a non-model logistic baseline converge on the same semantic-looking or geometric crystal candidates more often than matched shuffled controls, and do any surviving candidates repeat across visible and UV recordings of the same specimen?

planners.logistic_baseline: SHA-256-seeded coupled logistic map from the initial sandbox
planners.fractalgpt_sierpinski: recovered FractalGPT.sierpinski_triangle with deterministic RNG seeds
planners.fractalgpt_fbm: recovered FractalGPT.fractal_brownian_motion promoted from x/value into a 2-D scan path
planners.fractalgpt_model: actual tiny recovered FractalGPT instance trained for eight deterministic steps on short Koch sequences, then used to generate a trajectory

fixed_measurements: Tesseract OCR with restricted alphabet and confidence threshold
method.negative_control: every planner replays its exact windows on the same deterministic 48-pixel block-shuffled image
method.planner_local_escalation: token length >=3; >=2 real-window hits in one planner; absent from matched control; word/formula/code-like class
method.cross_planner_escalation: same planner-local admissible token independently survives >=2 planner families and is absent from all matched-control OCR
method.cross_modality_escalation: same cross-planner candidate repeats across >=2 recorded modalities
method.semantic_admission: never admitted as intentional message, formula, code or algorithm in this gate

recovered_model_training.interpretation: The recovered micro-model executed and changed under deterministic training; prediction quality is not treated as a scientific claim.

raw_single_window_ocr_examples_not_admit.note: Every listed token occurred only as isolated detector output and failed the planner-local repetition gate.

mirror_structure_consensus.metric: median left-right mirror correlation in real windows minus the same metric in matched block-shuffled-control windows
mirror_structure_consensus.reason: The effect may arise from specimen geometry, framing, lighting, camera/acquisition choices or other image-level structure; matched same-specimen acquisition controls are not yet available.

edge_and_line_structure.note: Real-minus-shuffled edge density and Hough line counts varied by source and planner and are not elevated into a material claim.

next_gate.name: FRACTALGPT_IMAGE_STRUCTURE_NULL_MODEL_HARDENING
requirements: add a second null model that preserves spatial-frequency power while destroying phase/shape
add a uniform-random planner baseline matched for scale distribution
test whether the 5-of-5 positive mirror-symmetry sign survives both null models
repeat on multiple independent quartz specimens and non-quartz transparent/mineral controls
separate acquisition/framing symmetry from specimen-bound symmetry
only after those controls consider calibrated same-specimen visible/UV/polarization experiments

claim_ceiling: The sandbox establishes deterministic recovered-FractalGPT execution, reproducible multi-planner detector behavior and an image-level mirror-structure candidate. It finds no admissible hidden message, formula, code or algorithm, and does not establish the mirror effect as an intrinsic quartz property.
